Published essay · September 2025Muted Histories: The Misrepresentation of African Musical Artifacts in Museums.Read the essay ↗

What does a museum preserve when it displays a musical instrument without its sound? After encountering a drum labelled simply “Ugandan,” I wrote about what such a description leaves out: the people who made it, the purposes it served, and the knowledge carried by the way it was played.

When my thoughts aren't haunting me, I'm turning them into fiction. I now have a pretty haunting repertoire of emotionally damaged characters and love-bound protagonists.

I share these fun little stories with family and friends (whose characters have not yet made their way into my fiction). I do write children's stories though, and I hope to one day publish them.
